about: ShopSmart is a mobile-first grocery price-comparison and smart-shopping app for the Canadian market, piloting in Edmonton, AB. It finds the cheapest per-item prices across multiple local stores and then either guides the shopper along an optimized multi-stop driving route with per-store checklists (Drive Mode) or dispatches an Uber Direct driver for curbside multi-stop pickup and home delivery (Delivery Mode). Price data starts crowdsourced from users (GasBuddy-style, with gamified points) and is later supplemented by flyer parsing and retailer partnerships. The repo currently contains the product/build spec, planning docs, and an interactive HTML screen mockup; the React Native/Expo app and Node/Express backend are specified but not yet implemented.
whyThis: Unlike GasBuddy (fuel only) or Flipp (flyer browsing with no routing or delivery), ShopSmart pairs true cheapest-per-item comparison across stores with actionable last-mile execution, turning a savings calculation into either an optimized driving route or a single multi-stop delivery. It is the only approach here wiring multi-store grocery optimization to a white-label multi-stop delivery API (Uber Direct), so users capture the savings without personally visiting several stores. Crowdsourced pricing avoids scraping and builds a defensible, community-driven data moat in one local market before expanding.
